correctness.rationale: PASS. For a bidirected bouquet of k triangles with a single chip at hub h and exact specified cyclic rotor order (increment-before-move), every nonhub directed rotor cycle is exactly the local two-cycle (a_j,b_j) with initial bits (1,0). By the recurrent-state unicycle criterion of Holroyd et al., the initially all-good states (3^k) are already recurrent. For any state with bad petals, scanning earlier petals in hub order costs six moves per good and four per bad, changing a bad petal to a good state; after the hub's arrival at the final bad petal J, the chip lies on the only remaining directed cycle. Thus first entry τ=6J−2B+1 (B prior bad petals), *not* first return to hub. Counting trailing good petals and independent preceding choices proves H_k(z)=3^k+Σ_{j=0}^{k−1}3^{k−1−j}z(z^4+3z^6)^j; H_k(1)=4^k, maximum 6k−5 has 3^{k−1} realizers. Differentiate at z=1 for Eτ=(11/2)k−21+21(3/4)^k. If S_k~Bin(k,1/4) and R=k−1−J is tight geometric trailing-good count, τ=6k−3−6R−2S_k on S_k>0. The binomial CLT yields normalization sqrt(3k/4). Independently implemented full deterministic chip+rotor orbit and first repetition, exhaustively checked all 1,364 initial assignments for k=1..5 against τ and H_k histogram, including maxima 1,7,13,19,25 and counts 1,3,9,27,81. Original verify_rotor.py source inspected; independent simulation corroborates the explicit all-k excursion proof.

value.rationale: PASS. Entry to full deterministic rotor recurrence on a natural cactus graph is distinct from Eulerian period and hub return time. The last-defect formula completely classifies labelled initial rotor states, yields a sharp rare maximal-delay shell and demonstrates Gaussian versus extremal clocks. This is a motivated natural exact initial-condition invariant, not a generic restatement of a unicycle criterion. Fixed ordering and initial hub state are essential limits.

limitations: Fixed hub rotor and cyclic order, peripheral rotor orders, one chip starting at h.
No conclusions for arbitrary hub initial rotor choices, chip starts, general cacti, or all graph types.
